rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for sustained concern or attention focused on A.

example.english: My preoccupation with my family's health means I keep reminding them to get some rest.
example.traditional: 我對家人健康嘅關注，令我成日提醒佢哋早啲休息。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 gaa1 jan4 gin6 hong1 ge3 gwaan1 zyu3 ling6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 tai4 sing2 keoi5 dei6 zou2 di1 jau1 sik1

rows.note: Use this when the preoccupation is an obsessive or fixated attachment to A.

example.english: Their preoccupation with losing weight means they refuse to eat half the time.
example.traditional: 佢哋對減肥嘅執著，搞到成日唔肯食飯。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 deoi3 gaam2 fei4 ge3 zap1 zoek6 gaau2 dou3 seng4 jat6 m4 hang2 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this when the preoccupation means being enthralled or fascinated by A.

example.english: My preoccupation with old Hong Kong films means I look for them whenever I have time.
example.traditional: 我對舊香港電影嘅著迷，令我一有時間就去搵嚟睇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 gau6 hoeng1 gong2 din6 jing2 ge3 zoek6 mai4 ling6 ngo5 jat1 jau5 si4 gaan3 zau6 heoi3 wan2 lai4 tai2
